title: Repeat Pauses and the Restart Re-Pricing of Professional Services Projects
content:
An engagement of Professional Services Projects that has already restarted after pauses carries points on a new restart re-pricing.

When two or more remobilization fees were posted on the engagement in the twelve months before the re-pricing date, 1.0 point is added to the restart re-pricing, 0.5 point when exactly one was, and none otherwise, a fee counting when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the re-pricing date, the day the client signs the restart change order. A whole month is complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Remobilization fees posted on the engagement in the twelve months | Points added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.0 |
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| none | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a remobilization fee posted on 20 June of one year counts toward a re-pricing signed on 19 June of the next year and not toward one signed on 20 June of the next year.
